No distributed or actual terminal concurrency claim.

access.rationale: Identity, source authority, grants, target/question/generation, ownership and forgotten lifecycle are enforced by host code rather than model intent.
access.countercheck: Mutated grants, cross-session reads/answers/stops, assistant-only confirmations and permission/auth answers are rejected; manual input blocks writes but permits observation.
access.anchor_support: Executed adversarial cross-boundary and lifecycle checks, including late callbacks after forgetting/reconciliation, validate scoped controls. No model tool/OS authority or product bridge expansion was introduced; trusted-host assumptions remain explicit.

input_secrets.rationale: Inputs are bounded, output errors omit raw values, secrets remain in launch environment and inference has no tools/settings persistence.
input_secrets.countercheck: Actual aliases work without per-project.env and actual values absent from nonignored source/results; cycle/depth/UTF8/HTTP boundaries and least-privilege SDK options tested.

abuse.rationale: Relevant resource and authority abuse has bounded contracts and immutable shared cost reservations.
abuse.countercheck: Oversized/deep/cyclic JSON,2MiB response overflow, unavailable permissions, excessive/unknown budget and replay cannot bypass the same controls. No public network endpoint or OOM/traffic attack claim.

failure.rationale: Expected partial failures are visible, preserve state/receipts and retain uncertain costs or external effects.
failure.countercheck: Failure before/during completion is injected at SQL,SDK close, HTTP stream/cancel and external acknowledgment; real-process fixtures distinguish pending from confirmed completion.

recovery.rationale: Local restart, replay, forgetting and interrupted external delivery/stop can be reconciled without silent resend.
recovery.countercheck: Real child exit and reopened file DB, idempotent receipts and stale-attempt callbacks verified. Host without inspect intentionally stays unknown and requires documented operator check.

resilience.rationale: Dependency errors and resource limits degrade to explicit rejection/unknown with bounded calls, time, bytes and spend.
resilience.countercheck: 429/503, malformed/refused/incomplete/disconnected/oversized output and cancellation tested; unknown reservations survive reopen. Outage conditions are fake transport, not provider load tests.

clarity.rationale: Principal contracts, ownership, errors,0.2 migration and evidence limits can be traced without treating historical docs as current.
clarity.countercheck: Followed action/state/decision/external paths and matched procedures to source and current results; no claims of human/product acceptance from fixtures.

change.rationale: Representative state/decision/transport changes remain within identifiable modules with meaningful regression detection.
change.countercheck: Known bugs fail old sources; fixes pass unchanged tests and public-entrypoint consumer checks; actual Prior CI detects format/source integration drift; after the user waived CI, later example-only changes have local/API checks.

debt.rationale: Current complexity is proportionate to a small core and thin example adapters; lexical special cases and opaque automatic fallback were removed.
debt.countercheck: New evaluation scripts, provider wire codec and manual recovery have explicit limits. One-day change evidence does not establish sustained maintenance cost or independent handover.

duplication.rationale: Shared generated instructions,schemas,model interface and host checks remain consistent across multiple entrypoints.
duplication.countercheck: Wire representation changes do not weaken original Zod bounds; nullable/native primitive/tagged aggregate cases and old-host parity detect divergent contracts.

reuse.rationale: Existing ModelAdapter, message builder,writer/receipt,observation/external ports and standard Zod/SQLite are used by actual consumers.
reuse.countercheck: Native2-provider inference and isolated Eumenes consume the same proposal boundary; core remains free of new runtime framework dependencies.

abstraction.rationale: Interfaces cover demonstrated proposal/storage/transport needs with little extra indirection.
abstraction.countercheck: Offline transformations, online requests, correction/replay and two transports use the same mechanisms without phrase/domain branches; actual product adoption is separate.

risk_coverage.rationale: Critical structural boundaries, invalid transitions, authority, publication, uncertain effects and interactions have defect-detecting checks.
risk_coverage.countercheck: Red controls establish old-state,combined-resource,SDK-close and stale-answer defects; real crash fixtures,SQL rollback,concurrency,provider fault matrix and actual consumer tests exercise different layers.
risk_coverage.anchor_support: 61 tests/747 assertions plus true pre-fix failures and fixed-host artifact checks validate representative high-risk interactions. Semantic/API evidence is separate and its failed gate remains visible; human/UI testing is not substituted.

quality.rationale: Assertions inspect saved state,receipts,returned status,actual files/process exit and forbidden effects rather than only mirroring helpers.
quality.countercheck: Known regressions genuinely fail previous implementations; fixtures use deferred promises/triggers rather than timing sleeps. Automated judge and browser-oracle limitations prevent exceptional semantic-test claims.

automation.rationale: Reproducible frozen checks execute in actual CI with fixed consumer and fail on regressions.
automation.countercheck: Successful runs on multiple current code commits and a real earlier failed formatting run observed. User explicitly waived further CI work; no ongoing release-attestation claim.

dependencies.rationale: Exact runtime provenance,patched dependency and reachability-aware advisory response are established.
dependencies.countercheck: Audit zero on3 production packages,resource regression checks and frozen consumer install; unpatched shared product-host dependency remains explicitly outside changes.

build_release.rationale: Real tarball,source/resource checksums,generated catalog checks and fixed-host installation validate basic update integrity.
build_release.countercheck: Installed bytes and149/601 parity checked after generation; source commit split for later example-only fix is explicit. No signed release, immutable action pin or reproducible cross-platform archive claim.

license.rationale: Actual own/runtime distribution conditions,complete3-package inventory and license/NOTICE files were checked.
license.countercheck: Package excludes SDK/example/results and declares runtime dependencies separately; MIT/Apache provenance and responsibility are explicit. Not legal advice or complete dev-toolchain license assurance.

budget.rationale: Representative bounded local operations and actual direct-model calls meet declared latency/resource/cost limits.
budget.countercheck: All-attempt spend retains unknowns below10USD and model calls are time/size capped; state max1000 measured against200ms. Quality failure is reported separately; no production budget certification.

hot_path.rationale: Map/Set bounded graph/state processing and transaction I/O fit measured0/999/1000fact conditions.
hot_path.countercheck: Candidate4.67ms vs baseline2.23ms at1000 shows safety overhead rather than invented speedup; escaped2MiB and combined-size boundaries have direct execution tests.

measurement.rationale: Reproducible local baseline/workload and live fixed-protocol latency/usage/cost evidence replace prior unknown measurements.
measurement.countercheck: Fixed corpus,commits,32task/21turn cases and180 local samples recorded. Pooled API timing,process RSS,one repetition and exposed holdout are disclosed; no arm-specific cost/tail causal claim.

signals.rationale: Typed reasons,revision/receipt,attempt/unknown and estimated-versus-reserved spend expose state and failure without raw secrets.
signals.countercheck: Injected failures can be diagnosed from distinct reason/status; false late success fixed at return boundary; logs and fixed source/digests make limitations traceable.

lifecycle.rationale: Library install/update,helper migration,restart/replay,forget and unsupported-version hold have usable exercised paths.
lifecycle.countercheck: Actual isolated artifact installation,SQLite reopen and crash recovery execute. Invalid legacy-state and product migration/rollback procedures require explicit host work; no oldDB restoration.

interaction.rationale: Developer-facing action/state/decision APIs and explicit recovery support basic tasks, but broad semantic interactions are not yet accepted.
interaction.countercheck: Claude21/32 misses90%; browser oracle has ambiguities and no real user/UI acceptance. Passing narrow writing pilot cannot erase this corpus limitation.

need.rationale: Concrete initial users are Eumenes developers/operators needing iterative clarification, correction and host-safe structured work. Recurrence is explicit in target workflow, not measured demand. Re-evaluation: the original limited capability remains; fixed-code/API evidence does not establish real business outcomes, migration cost or retained use.
